{{External|rs|rsc=Rune Chain Mail Body}} {{Infobox Item |name = Rune chainbody |image = [[File:Rune chainbody.png]] |release = [[26 July]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape updated (26 July 2001) |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = A series of connected metal rings. |value = 50000 |weight = 6.803 |exchange = Yes |id = 1113 }} [[File:Rune chainbody detail.png|120px|left]] A '''rune chainbody''' is a [[chainbody]] made of [[Rune equipment|runite]]. To wear this chainbody, a player needs at least level 40 [[Defence]]. This piece of body armour is less resistant than the [[rune platebody]] in all stats except [[Crush weapons|crush]] and [[magic]] and wearing it does not require completion of [[Dragon Slayer I]]. For this reason it is commonly worn by players who have not finished said quest or who are fighting against [[monster]]s that use crush attacks. It is also useful for rangers since it has higher defence bonuses than the [[green d'hide body]] and it does not penalise ranged attack. A player with 96 [[Smithing]] can make the chainbody by using three [[runite bar]]s on an [[anvil]], granting 225 Smithing [[experience]]. It can also be bought at [[Scavvo's Rune Store]] in the [[Champions' Guild]], or for [[members]], at [[Seddu's Adventurer's Store]] in [[Nardah]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -15 |arange = 0 |dstab = +63 |dslash = +72 |dcrush = +78 |dmagic = -3 |drange = +65 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = body |image = [[File:Rune chainbody equipped male.png]] |altimage = [[File:Rune chainbody equipped female.png]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 96 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 225 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Runite bar |mat1quantity = 3 |output1 = Rune chainbody }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Rune chainbody}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Rune chainbody}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 10 April 2006 |update = Rag and Bone Man |change = *The item was graphically updated. *The item's equip model was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 17 – 24 November 2004 |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Rune chainbody detail (historical, v1).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Rune chainbody detail (historical, v2).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Rune chainbody detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Rune chainbody (historical, v1).png|center]] |[[File:Rune chainbody (historical, v2).png|center]] |[[File:Rune chainbody.png|center]] |- |[[File:Rune chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Rune chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Rune chainbody equipped male.png|center|300x300px]] |- |29 March 2004 –
